messages:
maya: Final sync before marketplace push. Need quick confirms on three lanes: 1) hardware demo rack provisioning 2) SI connector smoke + chunking sample 3) press embargo timing + partner kit distribution. Who's got updates?

trent: Hardware side  EdgeRack confirmed 2x 2U slots (rack D4) and PDUs tested. Vendor will ship demo cables to on-site contact. Added rack photo to logistics doc.

sophie: SI side  shared chunked upload example and retry guidance in the SI onboarding sheet. Noted that staging had a 408 at ~52s on large uploads; recommend chunk size 8MB and exponential backoff (base 1s, max 16s).

maya: Can you paste the curl snippet here for partners to copy?

sophie: Sure: 
```
# chunked upload example (minimal)
curl -X PUT "https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/OBJID?part=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --data-binary @chunk-0001.bin
```
and we instruct to retry part uploads up to 5x with jitter.

trent: Ops question: will the rack demo use the marketplace staging SKU or a special demo SKU? We should avoid provisioning churn.

maya: Demo will point to staging SKU but uses demo tenant to avoid touching production provisioning. Ops pinned tenant-id demo-2026.

infra-bot: Rollout window reserved 09:30-09:50 PT. Health gates: listing success >= 98.5% AND median page load <850ms for a 5m rolling window. Auto-fallback: switch listing to "static-tiles" if errors exceed threshold. CDN invalidation at T+75s.

press-bot: Embargo plan: partners get secure kit at T-25m; embargo lift at 09:30 PT; press distribution at T via wire and targeted outlets. Kit URL will be private link (expires T+90m). Reminder: no quote changes after T.

maya: CTA decision time  A: "Try in Marketplace" vs B: "Launch Demo". Partner UX prefers A for parity; marketing leaning B for conversion. Vote now please.

trent: A (parity)

sophie: B (conversion)

maya: lean A to keep partner listings consistent; will accept B if legal flags trademark issue.

trent: One more: analytics UTMs? need utm_source & partner param.

maya: Using utm_source=marketplace, utm_partner={{partner_slug}}, utm_campaign=marketplace_q2_2026. Added to tracking sheet and tagged analytics.

press-bot: Confirmed UTMs included in press kit links and partner preview. Also adding campaign id to partner pixels to track partner referrals separately.

maya: Any remaining blockers? Please post single word: yes/no/blocker. If blocker, 1-line. We'll do final go/no-go at 08:45 PT.

trent: no

sophie: no

maya: Thanks  i'll open embargo lift channel at T-30m and coordinate partner handoff. If anyone sees a partner report during their 10:00 smoke, escalate to #support and tag me.
